purpose: Define Tier qualification using explicit Project and recommendation evidence, including the locked minimum of three qualifying recommendations and three qualifying Projects at the Tier.

value.qualification_rule: Tier requires at least three qualifying recommendations and three qualifying Projects at that Tier, plus any explicit Tier-specific criteria.
value.project_rule: Qualifying Project evidence resolves exact Project identities.
value.recommendation_rule: Qualifying recommendations resolve exact recommendation/author identities.
value.independence_rule: Project count and recommendation count are separate requirements and cannot substitute for each other.
value.review_rule: Negative feedback may trigger review rather than automatic opaque Tier mutation.
value.reduction_rule: Where policy permits Tier reduction, higher-Tier peer review/evidence is explicit.
value.recency_rule: No generic time decay applies; recency matters only where competence criteria explicitly require it.

invariants.rule: MeritCore derives human competence/trust history from explicit identity-bound Project evidence; identities, evidence, recommendations, points, Tier and broker relevance remain separate semantic dimensions.

hard_gates.condition: fewer than three Projects accepted without explicit compatible exception
generic time decay silently reduces Tier
negative feedback automatically changes Tier without review policy

references.purpose: Tier Project evidence uses canonical Projects.
